display.purpose: The day's listed-option count only. Largest thing on screen.

headline.purpose: The result heading and the site wordmark, sharing one class.

body.purpose: Claim text on every card; tabular numerals throughout.

label.purpose: Helper text, tagline, day-tile weekday, source/checked-date captions.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Option cards and an unfolded day-tile entry rest on the page.

shadows.name: action
shadows.purpose: Every amber pressable reads as raised: Directions, submit, Try another ZIP, Retry.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Shared transition-colors timing for every hover/active/selected color shift: primary and secondary buttons, pills, day tiles, and text-link underline thickness.

motion.name: reduced-motion-override
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion strips every transition and animation sitewide, including the day tile's expand/collapse, with no substitute state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one pressable-action style: Directions, submit, Try another ZIP, Retry.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-amber); color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(11,42,74,0.18); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-amber-deep); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-stakes action beside a primary one: Cancel, Print this list.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--color-navy); font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-navy); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--color-navy-soft); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A labeled text field, e.g. the ZIP code entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-field-input { width: 160px; max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-soft); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 1.125rem; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice Pill
components.description: A radio or checkbox choice styled as a pill, e.g. kitchen or travel options.
components.html: <label class="ds-pill ds-pill--selected"><input type="radio" name="ds-kitchen" checked />Full kitchen</label>
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-pill input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: var(--color-navy); } .ds-pill--selected { border-color: var(--color-navy); background: var(--color-navy); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-pill:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Day Tile
components.description: One of the six later-week tiles; toggles a day open, one at a time.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); text-align: center; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-tile-day { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tile-date { font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-tile-count { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-amber-deep); } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: var(--color-navy); } .ds-tile:active { background: var(--color-navy-soft); } .ds-tile--open { border-color: var(--color-navy); background: var(--color-navy); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-tile--open .ds-tile-count--open { color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Option Card
components.description: One listed option: a time block beside its claims and a Directions action.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-paper); padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(11,42,74,0.12); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-card { flex-direction: row; gap: 20px; } } .ds-card-time { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; align-self: flex-start; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-navy); color: var(--color-paper); padding: 8px 16px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-card-time { width: 128px; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; text-align: center; gap: 0; padding: 12px 16px; } } .ds-card-time-value { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-card-time-sep { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-navy-soft); } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-line { color: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Tab Switch
components.description: The two-item entry-point switch at the top of the page: Find food today / Understand my letter.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tab { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 16px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-tab:hover { border-color: var(--color-navy); } .ds-tab--selected { border-color: var(--color-navy); background: var(--color-navy); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-quote { border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-navy-soft); padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-quote-caption { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink-soft); margin: 0; } .ds-quote-text { margin: 4px 0 0; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: An inline navy underlined link: phone numbers, source and help-route URLs.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--color-navy); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; transition: text-decoration-thickness 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-panel { border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-navy); color: var(--color-paper); padding: 24px 20px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-panel { padding: 32px 28px; } } .ds-panel-heading { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-panel-heading { font-size: 2.25rem; } } .ds-panel-count { margin-top: 8px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-panel-count-number { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-amber); }

narrative.overview:
GoodNext borrows a shape people already read correctly — today big, the rest of the week small — and refuses to look like the thing it must not be mistaken for: a benefits portal's list of identical rows. Decision 007 turned down a Checkout Receipt world specifically because it carried more identity than a scannable task screen needs. What shipped instead spends almost the whole page on structure and words, and saves color for two jobs only: something a resident can press, and something they can count.

The result reads as calm rather than unfinished. One typeface carries a giant amber count numeral, a navy header field, and an eight-word source line at the same weight of restraint. Nothing on the screen competes with the number the whole page exists to answer.

Two confirmed rejections shape everything below: no dark theme (the use scene is a daylight phone or a library terminal, never a dim room), and no device the system doesn't already use natively — no hard-offset shadow, no icon glyph, no second typeface waiting to become "the brand font."
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, rationed to pressable and countable things only.
A single navy field carries almost all of the screen's visual weight; everything else is paper, ink, or a thin line.
One typeface, one tabular-numeral rule, no display face.
Two radii, two shadows, and a hard rule that a shadow and a border never share an element.
Status is always a sentence first, a color second.

rules.name: The One Pressable Color Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on something a resident can press or something they can count. A status word, however important, is never amber. Everything else on screen is navy, paper, ink, or line.

rules.name: The Word-First Status Rule
rules.body: Every state — submitting, delayed, partial, no-match, unavailable — is a sentence before it is a color. Color is a second signal, never the only one.

rules.name: The State-Is-A-Color-Step Rule
rules.body: Every hover or active state is a deeper or softer step of the same palette — amber to amber-deep, a navy outline filling with navy-soft, a thin underline thickening — never a new hue and never a shadow. transition-colors carries the change and prefers-reduced-motion removes it cleanly.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: The system sans stack is the whole hierarchy, from the count to the caption. No serif, no display face, no icon font. This is a deliberate OWN-WORLD choice, not a placeholder waiting for a brand font.

rules.name: The Shadow-Or-Border Rule
rules.body: An element gets a soft shadow or a 1px line border, never both.

rules.name: The Two-Radius Rule
rules.body: 16px for anything you rest on; 12px for anything you press or type into. No third radius.

dos: Do keep amber to things a resident can press or count. Nothing else earns it.
Do pair every status with a sentence, not just a color change.
Do use the Card shadow and the 1px line border as alternatives, never together.
Do carry the 12px/16px corner split into any new control or container.
Do trust the palette's own contrast — every shipped text/background pair already clears 5.9:1; don't dial back to a lighter tint for "softness."

Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: the global rule strips every transition and animation, including the day tile's expand/collapse and every hover/active color shift, with no fallback state to design around.
Do carry the browser-chrome theming — amber-on-ink text selection, navy-on-navy-soft scrollbar, tabular numerals — into any new page; it's a sitewide rule, not a one-off.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, a display serif, or an icon set. The system sans and text alone carry the whole hierarchy.
Don't give any hover or active state a new hue, a shadow, or a size change — the vocabulary is a deeper/softer step of the existing palette, or a thicker underline, nothing else.
Don't use line (#cfd6df) for anything but a decorative section border; it is not a text or icon color.
Don't reach for a hard-offset or neobrutalist shadow. Both shadows in this system are soft and diffuse.
Don't add a third border radius outside the 12px/16px pair. Re-skin native sub-controls (the file-picker button) to 12px rather than letting a browser default through.
